G4-B02-COND-001.defect: ConditionService::RestoreSnapshot accepted restore while the definition/provider registry was still mutable, so restored instances could be admitted before the current-build registry contract was frozen.
G4-B02-COND-001.fix: EngineFramework/GameplayWorldStateOwners/Conditions/src/conditions.cpp::ConditionService::RestoreSnapshot now requires frozen registry before snapshot validation/publication.

G4-B02-EFF-001.defect: EffectService::Execute bounded derived effects per parent but not the aggregate next wave against remaining max_effects. Multiple committed parents could therefore queue more derived work than the total execution budget and force result/vector growth after handler side effects had already committed.
G4-B02-EFF-001.fix: EngineFramework/GameplayWorldStateOwners/Effects/src/effects.cpp::EffectService::Execute pre-reserves accepted result storage and admits derived work only when it fits both per-parent and remaining total execution budget; counters saturate instead of wrapping.

G4-B02-EFF-002.defect: EffectService::RestoreSnapshot accepted restore before handler/definition registry Freeze, allowing persistence validation against registry state that could still change afterward.

G4-B02-EFF-003.defect: EffectService::Execute could return a top-level Failure when framework-owned PrepareWave storage failed on a derived wave after an earlier handler Commit had already succeeded. A caller could interpret that result as an unaccepted execution and retry an already committed side effect.
G4-B02-EFF-003.fix: EngineFramework/GameplayWorldStateOwners/Effects/src/effects.cpp::EffectService::Execute now treats post-accept derived-wave staging failure as a terminal failed batch within the already accepted execution. Pre-accept first-wave staging failure still returns top-level Failure.

G4-B02-INT-001.defect: InteractionService::RestoreSnapshot accepted restore before definition/provider/executor registry Freeze, weakening restore validation against the final current-build interaction registry.

G4-B02-OWN-001.defect: OwnershipService::ResolveClaim used compressed single-line control flow that triggers GCC -Wmisleading-indentation under the B02 portable warnings-as-errors audit.
G4-B02-OWN-001.fix: EngineFramework/GameplayWorldStateOwners/Ownership/src/ownership.cpp::OwnershipService::ResolveClaim was reformatted into unambiguous structured control flow without semantic changes.

G4-INFRA-001.defect: Six B02 admission test sources used process-global allocation/fault sweep helpers as Goal 4 evidence, coupling unrelated allocations and preventing narrow ownership-local failure injection. Conditions did not use the global helper on the supplied baseline.
G4-INFRA-001.fix: The six baseline users were migrated to module-private/internal deterministic fault seams. Conditions uses the same local restore seam convention as additional B02 evidence. Restore coverage now exercises candidate-construction and pre-commit publication boundaries; shared allocation/sweep helpers remain read-only for serial removal after all Bxx merge.
G4-INFRA-001.module: B02 / seven owned modules (six baseline global-helper users)
